summary: PictShare is a multilingual image hosting service that provides a straightforward API for uploading and resizing pictures. It is written in PHP and packaged as a Docker container for self-hosting. The platform falls into the file transfer category, specifically supporting drag-and-drop and single-click upload workflows.
goodFor: It suits anyone who wants a dedicated, self-hosted endpoint for quick image uploads and programmatic resizing without heavy resource requirements.
watchOut: The project lacks a recent tagged release and shows signs of slowing maintenance activity, which could impact security patch availability over time.
deployNotes: Because it runs on PHP via Docker, you will typically need to map a persistent volume for uploaded files and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
